title: G's Dash
description: Driver display and car hub in seven looks (M Style, GT, Digital '84, Sim Racing, Lumen, Pixel, Vector). Swipe between Showcase (the car, Spotify or a clock), Drive (opens first; shift lights, gear, rpm, speed, g-meter, drive mode badge, oil / coolant in °F or °C), Warm-up (warm-up rev limit), G-force (peak hold) and Tires (TPMS). Optional Spotify panel (art, previous / play-pause / next, seek; own QR sign-in, Spotify Premium and mgu-uplink internet). Optional CarPlay map in the cluster: CarPlay's map on the instrument cluster through the separately installed Waze on cluster tool (off unless installed and turned on). Cluster source (0.8.3, Options > Cluster source, Auto by default): pick what the cluster's centre map area shows - Auto (as before), Logo (also while G's Dash runs in the background), Music (G's Music's lyrics / visualizer, the logo when nothing plays), Map (Waze on cluster's CarPlay map) or Stock (the car's own; Waze on cluster off); route guidance always shows directions, G's TV only after its own Cluster button; shared with G's Music and G's TV. Cluster logo (Auto): while open, the G's Dash logo in the cluster's centre map area unless route guidance runs (over Waze's map too; it steps aside only for the car's navigation, CarPlay or Android Auto route guidance, and for G's TV; with no route signal from the car it stays shown), through the separately installed Cluster renderer tool (on by default; nothing happens without the tool). 0.13.1: the cluster logo in your look - each look draws its own G (M Style carbon, GT yellow, Digital '84 teal segments, Sim Racing, Lumen neon; Pixel keeps its emblem), drawn by the renderer's GPU so it takes none of its memory and stays still while driving (if the renderer cannot draw it, the look's own picture or the regular logo shows instead); switching looks never holds two logo pictures at once. 0.13.0: the HUD slimmed to a big gear and a tach - the gear D3 style (the selector's letter, then the gear; R, N, D as letters; none in P) under a tach arc with the shift-light colours built in, the whole arc flashing past the shift point, in every look; compact (the gear 70 px tall, half the 0.12 HUD's, the tach to scale, centred where the 0.12 HUD sat, the same in every look); the speed is left to the car's own HUD; it uses far less of the renderer's memory (about 0.4 MiB a look, was up to 8 MiB). Cluster pictures (skins, HUD, full-screen test) show only once the renderer reports them uploaded whole (on a failed or partial upload the last picture stays), and the log gets a line for failed / partial uploads and a memory watchdog line (the renderer's peak, ours and who else held it, any refusals) when memory runs high; pages, skins and Showcase unchanged. 0.12.1: fixes head unit crashes with the HUD on (switching looks, also with favourites, swiping pages while driving): on a look switch the old look's cluster / HUD pictures are let go and the renderer has confirmed it before the new look's are sent (both at once could exceed the cluster renderer's 16 MiB for a moment), a quick run of look switches sends only the last one, and the renderer's memory is checked before sending; looks the same. 0.12.0: Full-screen cluster test (Options > Diagnostics, TEST; off by default and never saved - off again after every app or head unit restart): classic twin round dials over the whole cluster panel (speedometer 0-160 mph, tachometer red from 7,000 rpm, coolant and oil °F sub-dials, no fuel; a centre display with the drive mode, the gear - P / R / N, D3 style in drive - the clock H:MM and the oil temperature), original art; any gear or speed; covers the car's warning lights while on; the cluster skins and HUD pause meanwhile; fades back to stock within a second on a late signal or anything wrong, and by itself if G's Dash stops (about 1.1 MiB of the renderer's 16 MiB). 0.11.3: the HUD and cluster dials no longer flicker (the HUD could strobe with the car's own HUD under it when the renderer's HUD takeover was on): their fail-safe is renewed without a gap, they stay fully shown while the values are fresh and hide only when a value is late or something is wrong; the log counts shown / hidden changes and re-arms every 30 s for diagnosis. 0.11.2: Cluster dials fit beside the CarPlay map, G's Music and G's TV (they could show 'Refused: the service's pixel memory is full'): the dials use under half the cluster renderer's shared memory, look the same; when the memory is full anyway G's Dash frees its own and tries once more, and Options says 'Cluster memory full' with what else is using it. 0.11.1: the G-force page always shows the live g-meter readouts on the right (never Spotify; Drive's right panel unchanged). 0.11.0: Showcase redesigned - the look's own flowing wave background, the car on a soft floor shadow, a big clock and the date, the G mark and your logo straight on the background (pictures shown as they are, smooth and without fringes); Showcase shows: Spotify when playing (else the clock) or Clock only, and Showcase background brightness 100 % down to 15 % to darken the waves only (Options > Theme, with a live preview); cleaner Spotify controls on Showcase and Drive (no boxes, large round targets, a filled play / pause button, a thin seek bar with its times); M Style redesigned as Carbon Grid (graphite cards on a carbon grid, the gauges lined up on its columns, the tach across the whole width with numerals on the 1000-rpm marks); oil / coolant colour zones in every look (blue cold, green normal, red too hot: coolant below 160 / 160-230 / above 230 °F, oil below 160 / 160-260 / above 260 °F); favourites: only a tap on the gear switches looks (not the speed), and Drive shows no star. 0.10.0: a new Options page (Theme, Cluster & HUD, Driving, Spotify, Diagnostics; a Dash button on every page back to the dash); Your look on the car's displays: Cluster dials, HUD or Neither (one setting, 0.9.0's choice kept); favourite looks: star looks on Theme, then tap the gear on Drive to switch between them (not while the shift lights build or flash); every clock H:MM with a colon, from the head unit's clock (the car keeps it set; Diagnostics lists the catalog's time / date fields for a car clock). Cluster skins (0.8.1: parked and driving): in any drive mode (the cluster's M / Sport layout), the speedometer, tachometer, digital speed and gear redrawn live in the G's Dash look; fuel, oil, ACC / speed limit / assist graphics and telltales stay the car's own; stock again within a second if a signal is late or anything is wrong; and Options > Diagnostics > Refresh cluster to remake G's Dash's cluster layers. HUD (gear, tach, shift lights) (0.9.0, off by default; 0.13.0: no speed - the car's own HUD shows it): the whole HUD in the look's style - the gearbox's own gear, big (D3 style; none in P or unknown) and a tach arc with the shift-light colours over the last 2000 rpm, the whole arc flashing at the shift point; hidden on a late signal, no speed signal or any renderer error; no speed limit; one at a time with the cluster skins. 0.9.0: Simple, Heritage and Flight removed (a saved one becomes M Style, now the default); the fuel option removed (Drive shows oil / coolant; the cluster skins leave the car's own fuel gauge showing). 0.8.5: the cluster skins draw again (0.8.4's shader used a name the Cluster renderer reserves, so it was refused and showed 'Refused: no such layer'); skins and HUD lights are used only once the renderer confirms them, a refusal shows its real reason, and a layer the renderer loses is made again once. Tested tools (0.8.4): Waze on cluster 0.6.3 or later (tested 0.7.1; shows its patch service starting / unavailable and why a build cannot be patched), Cluster renderer 0.2.2, GPU renderer 0.5.0 or later (current 0.6.8). 0.13.2: Remote logs (Options > Diagnostics): after a crash, or when you tap Send logs now, the last session's log is scrubbed of personal details, encrypted on the car and sent to a private drop (only once one is installed on the unit; otherwise 'Not set up' and nothing leaves the car); on / off switch and the last-sent time on the card. 0.13.3: a new install starts with Neither on the car's displays (pick Cluster dials or HUD in Options; a saved pick is kept), the HUD marked experimental; remote logs collect and send nothing unless the unit's own drop file (with its own address and key) is installed. 0.13.4: remote logs keep the last few minutes of HUD, cluster, look-switch and memory lines in a small ring on the unit (at most 96 KB, written in batches a few times a minute) so a crash or head unit restart still has them; the ring goes into the next crash report and Send logs now, scrubbed and encrypted like the log; only with the unit's own drop file installed and Remote logs on, otherwise nothing is kept. 0.13.5: the top bar shows the app's name once: the header now always covers the head unit's own (larger) title, whose end used to show beside ours as a second, partial name. 0.13.6: Options has a Units tile where the G-meter tile was (the G-meter size and Reset peaks stay on the Driving page, which Engine & warm-up opens; its line now names the G-meter too): speed in mph or km/h, temperatures in °F or °C, tire pressure in psi, bar or kPa, on Drive in every look, Warm-up, Tires and the full-screen cluster test (a 0..320 km/h dial); mph, °F and psi stay the defaults; the warm-up zones and Engine settings keep their values, only the unit shown changes. The cluster dials and the head unit's own settings list stay in mph and °F. Full screen, the page's background now reaches the left edge (where a black bar ran beside the head unit's back arrow); only a small see-through box around the arrow and the strip under the home mark stay the head unit's; nothing to press there, no extra memory. Options' top line shows the installed version (it read 0.13.0 since then). 0.13.7: the cluster skins follow Options > Units: in km/h every look (Stock included) shows its speedo labelled 0, 40 .. 320 km/h on the same arc, with km/h as its unit and the digital speed in km/h (three digits); mph stays the default and its art is unchanged. Changing the unit remakes the skin the way a look switch does (the old pictures freed first, a quick run of changes makes the last only, the cluster's memory checked first); nothing more is sent while it stays. The skins draw no temperature or pressure (the small fuel and oil gauges stay the car's own) and the HUD shows no unit. The G's Dash Settings list shows the oil and coolant temperatures in °C when °C is chosen (the values kept in °F); the head unit's own fallback settings screen keeps °F. The alignment card stays in the car's own units. 0.13.9: a G's Dash on cluster & HUD switch (Options > Cluster & HUD, top; saved, On by default): Off leaves the cluster and HUD to the car - no logo, dials, HUD or test, nothing asked for again, Stock shared so G's Music stays out too. Each cluster pick says what it shows in plain words and is dimmed with the reason when it cannot show it now (e.g. Map: CarPlay is not sending a map); the Now card shows what the renderer and Waze on cluster confirm is on the cluster and, for Stock, why Waze's map may stay after a route. 0.14.0: Vector, a new look - thin lines on a measuring grid, crisp numerals - in Ice (default), Motorsport, Amber and White; Digital '84 in Green (default, as before), Purple or Red. Pick a look's colour with the swatches on the Options Theme card or on the chosen card in the Theme gallery (each look keeps its own; the cluster dials, HUD, logo and Showcase follow it). Only the chosen colour's cluster pictures are loaded, swapped the way a look switch is (the old let go first, the cluster's memory checked first), and a look's fonts load only when it is used. 0.14.1: the gear shows the gearbox program the way the car's own cluster does, on cars that send it: D in drive, DS in the S program, M and the gear (M3) in the M program - on Drive in every look, the cluster dials, the HUD and the full-screen cluster test; P, R and N as before; a car that does not send it shows the gear exactly as before.

de.bmw.infotainment.drivingexcitement.FE._optional: the drive mode badge: statusFESVehicleDynamicSwitchHMI.actualValueModeDrivingExperience (enum ActualValueModeDrivingExperience2, by name or number); its pop-up request flags mark a change

de.bmw.infotainment.misc.MDrive._optional: the gearbox program beside the gear (DS, M3): dataDisplayGearbox.displayProgramGearbox (S / M program, by name or number; notifier only); without it the gear shows as before

de.bmw.infotainment.vehicle.TPMS._optional: the Tires screen: pressures, temperatures, targets, status (UInt16 raw: pressure x0.1 in the car's unit, temperature raw-40; read every 10 s; raw values logged and on the diagnostics page)

de.bmw.infotainment.vehicle.Vehicle._optional: the car's display units (air pressure, temperature) for the TPMS values

de.bmw.infotainment.navigation.navigatio._optional: the cluster logo's route guidance check: guidingState (INACTIVE / CALCULATING_ROUTE / ACTIVE; ACTIVE hides the logo); without it the logo goes by the phone's signals, and with none it stays shown

de.bmw.infotainment.a4a.carplay.CarPlayM._optional: the cluster logo's CarPlay route guidance check (Waze or Maps with a route): projectedGuidanceActive; without it the logo shows over Waze's map during a CarPlay route too

de.bmw.infotainment.sdi.aap.androidautop._optional: the cluster logo's Android Auto route guidance check: projectedGuidanceActive

startWidget.comment: Home-screen widget: just the G logo, large and centred (widget_logo.js from tools/make_g_icon.py: the mark alone, transparent, at 'size' and inside 'safe'). Same layout and cells as upstream's apps/edrive widget (BMW's Drive Recorder widget on this firmware): the picture goes into BackgroundImage1; every text line and the progress bar are written empty here once per placed widget. The small widget shows no pictures on this firmware (upstream's finding), so main.js sets its Title to the app's name; the big one's Title stays empty. 'safe' = share of width / height kept clear on each side (the HMI crops the edges).
